title: Qatari emir hosts French president for official talks
summary: Qatar's Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al-Thani hosted French President Emmanuel Macron for official talks at Lusail Palace, marking the first state visit by a French leader to Qatar. The discussions focused on strengthening bilateral cooperation across various sectors, including economic, investment, security, and defense, as Macron also seeks to secure additional diesel supplies during his Gulf visit.

title: Iran to Pakistan’s army chief: No talks with Washington before our demands are met
summary: Iran has informed Pakistan’s Army Chief that it will not engage in talks with Washington until its demands are fulfilled, emphasizing its firm stance despite mediation efforts by Pakistan.

title: Albania PM blames ‘hybrid war’ for week of unrest
summary: Albanian Prime Minister Edi Rama attributed the recent week of violent protests in Tirana to a "hybrid war," claiming foreign actors are fueling unrest driven by genuine grievances such as corruption and rising living costs. The clashes between demonstrators and police have resulted in hundreds of injuries and increased calls for Rama's resignation, as the protests evolved from opposition to a controversial resort development into widespread anti-government sentiment.
